svg.desc: A dictionary maps each key to a node in a doubly linked list ordered by recency: user 7 most recent at the front, user 1 least recent at the back and evicted next. get moves a hit to the front; put inserts at the front and evicts the back when full.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An LRU cache: a hash map plus a doubly linked list

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The map finds a node in O(1); the list keeps recency order and evicts from the back in O(1).
